meta.promptText: Which brand's formal shirts should I buy for men in India?

response.text:
If you want **good formal shirts for men in India**, I’d rank the brands like this:

| Brand | Best for | Typical sweet spot |
|---|---|---:|
| **Van Heusen** | Best overall / everyday office | ₹1,000–₹2,500 |
| **Louis Philippe** | Premium, polished look | ₹1,400–₹3,500 |
| **Arrow** | Crisp, traditional corporate style | ₹1,500–₹3,500 |
| **Raymond** | Classic quality and formal occasions | ₹1,000–₹3,500 |
| **Park Avenue** | Good value for regular office wear | ₹900–₹2,000 |
| **Peter England** | Budget-friendly wardrobe | ₹800–₹1,500 |
| **Blackberrys** | Sharper/slimmer contemporary fit | ₹1,500–₹3,000 |


Recent 2026 comparisons consistently put Van Heusen, Louis Philippe, Arrow, Raymond and Park Avenue among the stronger mainstream choices. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My recommendation

**If you're buying just one brand: go with Van Heusen.** It offers a particularly good balance of fit, professional styling, fabric choices and price. [barkhaboutique.com](https://barkhaboutique.com/compare/marks-spencer-vs-van-heusen-vs-arrow-formal?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Van Heusen Men's Solid Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,029*

### [Louis Philippe Men's Regular Fit Easy-to-Iron Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,424*

### [Raymond Men Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹887*

### [Park Avenue Men Striped Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹960*

For a **5-shirt work wardrobe**, I'd buy:
- 2 × **white**
- 2 × **light blue**
- 1 × **very subtle stripe/check**
- Prefer **cotton or cotton-rich** fabric; wrinkle-resistant blends are useful if you travel or don't want to iron frequently. [dressingschool.com](https://dressingschool.com/picks/formal-shirts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**One important point:** fit matters more than the logo. A ₹1,200 shirt that fits your shoulders, chest and sleeves properly will look better than a ₹3,000 shirt in the wrong cut.

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. ₹1,000, ₹2,000 or ₹3,000 per shirt)** and whether you want **slim fit or regular fit**, I can narrow it down to the best 3–5 shirts currently available in India.
